in_sanskrit.name: अक्रिति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Akriti in Sanskrit is derived from the Sanskrit words 'akrit' which means 'boundless' and 'iti' which means 'this'. Thus, Akriti can be interpreted as 'this which is boundless' or 'the one who is boundless'. It can also be translated as 'limitless' or 'endless'.

in_hindi.name: अक्रिति
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Akriti in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'akrit' which means 'boundless' and 'iti' which means 'this'. It translates to 'अक्रिति' (pronounced 'akriti') in Hindi and retains the same meaning as in Sanskrit.

in_tamil.name: அக்ரிதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Akriti in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'akrit' which means 'boundless'. It translates to 'அக்ரிதி' (pronounced 'akriti') in Tamil and retains the same meaning as in Sanskrit.

in_telugu.name: అక్రితి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Akriti in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'akrit' which means 'boundless'. It translates to 'అక్రితి' (pronounced 'akriti') in Telugu and means 'limitless, endless, or infinite'.

in_marathi.name: Akriti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Skillful, Expert, Intelligent
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akriti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akriti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'akr' which means 'to do' or 'to make'. The suffix 'iti' means 'she who does'. This name signifies a skillful, expert, and intelligent woman.
